title: BECE Mathematics Geometry & Measurement - Mathematics - Geometric Construction
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which instrument is primarily used to draw arcs and circles in geometry?
questions.explain: A pair of compasses is the standard tool for drawing circles and arcs.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: To construct an angle of $60^\circ$, which shape is effectively being constructed first?
questions.explain: Drawing a $60^\circ$ angle involves creating the geometry of an equilateral triangle where all angles are $60^\circ$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: When bisecting a line segment AB, the arcs drawn from A and B must have a radius:
options: Equal to the length of AB
Less than half the length of AB
Greater than half the length of AB
questions.explain: To ensure the arcs intersect, the radius must be greater than half the distance between the centers (points A and B).
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which angle is obtained by bisecting a $90^\circ$ angle?
questions.explain: Bisecting divides an angle into two equal parts. $90 / 2 = 45^\circ$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The locus of points equidistant from two fixed points A and B is:
questions.explain: The set of all points equidistant from two endpoints of a segment is the perpendicular bisector of that segment.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which of these angles cannot be constructed using only a pair of compasses and a ruler?
questions.explain: $50^\circ$ is not a standard constructible angle (unlike $90$, $60$, $45$, $30$, $15$, etc.). It requires a protractor.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: To construct a $30^\circ$ angle, one would typically bisect which angle?
questions.explain: $60^\circ$ is easily constructed, and bisecting it gives $30^\circ$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: In constructing a perpendicular to a line from a point P on the line, the first step is to:
options: Draw a circle with P as center cutting the line at two points
Draw a line parallel to the given line
Use a protractor to mark 90 degrees
questions.explain: Using compasses, one places the point on P and marks arcs on either side of P on the line to create equidistant reference points.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: What is the instrument used to measure angles?
questions.explain: A protractor is used to measure angles in degrees.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: When constructing a triangle with sides $3 \text{ cm}$, $4 \text{ cm}$, and $5 \text{ cm}$, what is the resulting triangle type?
questions.explain: Since $3^2 + 4^2 = 9 + 16 = 25 = 5^2$, it satisfies Pythagoras' theorem and is a right-angled triangle.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The locus of points at a constant distance from a fixed point O is:
questions.explain: This is the definition of a circle.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: To construct an angle of $75^\circ$, which two angles can be added together?
questions.explain: $45^\circ + 30^\circ = 75^\circ$. These are both standard constructible angles.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which pair of set squares is typically found in a geometry box?
questions.explain: Standard geometry sets contain two set squares: one $30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ$ and one $45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: If you are asked to construct triangle ABC given $|AB|=6 \text{ cm}$, $|BC|=7 \text{ cm}$, and $|AC|=5 \text{ cm}$, which construction method is used?
questions.explain: You are given three sides, so it is the SSS construction method.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: What is the value of the angle created by bisecting the angle between the perpendicular bisector and the line segment itself?
questions.explain: The angle between a perpendicular bisector and the segment is $90^\circ$. Bisecting this yields $45^\circ$.
questions.subject: Mathematics
